clue.text: Italian school's language

parts.note: a Roman is an Italian, a native of Rome
SCH is a standard abbreviation for school

explanation.surface: Asks what language is taught at an Italian school.
explanation.definitionFit: Romansch is the Romance tongue spoken in parts of Switzerland, one of its national languages.

clue.text: Gold book that is included coming from the east

indicators.note: included says the abbreviation for that is sits within the gold-and-book pair

parts.note: OR is the heraldic term for gold
NT, the New Testament, is a book of the Bible
IE (id est) is the Latin abbreviation for that is

explanation.surface: Describes a gilded volume with an eastern origin.
explanation.definitionFit: As an adjective, orient is a poetic word meaning eastern, belonging to the lands of the rising sun.

clue.text: Celia's new name

indicators.note: new tells us the letters of Celia form a fresh arrangement

parts.note: the name Celia, its possessive ending supplying no letters, is the fodder

explanation.surface: Celia has changed her name, perhaps after marriage.
explanation.definitionFit: Alice is a common girl's first name.

clue.text: Honestly trust followed after that time

indicators.note: followed says the word for trust comes after the time phrase

parts.note: since means from or after that time
to rely on someone is to trust them

explanation.surface: Someone sincerely trusted from then on.
explanation.definitionFit: Sincerely and honestly are synonyms, both meaning truthfully and without pretence.

clue.text: Livery man Patrick in charge

parts.note: a man is a he
Pat is the short form of Patrick

explanation.surface: Introduces Patrick as the man running a livery business.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Livery' looks like the noun for uniforms or a horse stable, but here it is an adjective: to do with the liver.
explanation.definitionFit: Hepatic means relating to the liver, which the clue's whimsical adjective livery suggests.

clue.text: He is in finest order

indicators.note: in places the pronoun within the word for finest

parts.note: best means finest

explanation.surface: A boast that he is in the very best condition.
explanation.definitionFit: A behest is a command, an instruction given by someone in authority.

clue.text: Composer's perfect joy

definitions.meaning: Sir Arthur ... was an English composer, Master of the Queen's Music

explanation.surface: Speaks of a composer's moment of pure happiness.
explanation.definitionFit: The surname of the English composer Arthur matches the word for utter happiness or rapture.

clue.text: Silence is golden when this is paid?

definitions.text: Silence is golden when this is paid?

parts.words: Silence is golden when this is paid?
parts.note: the proverb about silence being golden is taken literally: money handed over to buy someone's silence

explanation.surface: A twist on the proverb that silence is golden.
explanation.definitionFit: A bribe paid to keep someone quiet about a secret is literally gold in exchange for silence.

clue.text: One who chooses to remove corselet

indicators.note: remove read as re-move: the letters of corselet are moved into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone decides to take off a corselet.
explanation.definitionFit: A selector picks, for example the members of a sports team.

clue.text: Servant wearing short skirt

parts.note: a mini is a short skirt
if you have something on, you are wearing it

explanation.surface: A servant dressed in a miniskirt.
explanation.definitionFit: A minion is a subordinate or underling who serves a master.

clue.text: Ministerial rites arranged during work out

indicators.note: during sets the rearranged letters within the word for work out

parts.note: to ply a trade is to work at it steadily

indicators.note: arranged means the letters of rites are put in a different order

explanation.surface: Rites put together during some form of exercise for church ministers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Ministerial' suggests government, but it is the church sense that is meant.
explanation.definitionFit: Priestly describes things relating to clergy, as does ministerial in its church sense.

clue.text: Capital return

parts.note: what money invested as capital earns, though capital also suggests a trip back to a city

explanation.definitionFit: Money lent or deposited earns a percentage, the yield an investor receives on their sum.

clue.text: Equal amount thus with great quantity

parts.note: so means thus, in this way
much means a great quantity

explanation.surface: Reads like a description of measuring out matching portions.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase is used for a matching quantity, as in so much for each guest.

clue.text: Nice views might be seen through it

definitions.text: Nice views might be seen through it

parts.words: Nice views might be seen through it
parts.note: Nice is the city on the French Riviera, so views of Nice come through a glazed door from France

explanation.definitionFit: A pair of glazed doors opening onto a garden, named after France, where Nice is.

clue.text: Conversely it means there is only a slim hope

definitions.text: Conversely it means there is only a slim hope

parts.words: Conversely it means there is only a slim hope
parts.note: the idiom says the opposite of its words: a fat opportunity in fact means a slim one

explanation.definitionFit: The ironic idiom means very little likelihood, the reverse of its literal sense of plump odds.

clue.text: Flood turbulent pool after game

indicators.note: after places the stirred-up letters behind the word for flood

parts.note: a flood is water

indicators.note: turbulent means the letters of pool are stirred up into a new order

explanation.surface: A flood leaves a pool churning after some sporting fixture.
explanation.definitionFit: Water polo is a team ball sport played in a swimming pool.

clue.text: Large number on track of vapour left

parts.note: C is the Roman numeral for a hundred, a large number
a trail is a track

explanation.surface: Describes many trails of vapour left in the sky.
explanation.definitionFit: A contrail is the streak of condensed vapour left behind by a high-flying aircraft.

clue.text: How pianist repeatedly played in a cautious and gentle way

definitions.text: in a cautious and gentle way

indicators.note: repeatedly says the word for how the pianist played appears twice

parts.note: a pianist might play piano, that is softly

explanation.surface: A pianist who plays quietly over and over in a careful manner.
explanation.definitionFit: The doubled adverb is an idiom for a careful, patient approach that avoids force.

clue.text: Where return ticket takes one in Australia

definitions.text: Where return ticket takes one in Australia

parts.words: Where return ticket takes one in Australia
parts.note: a return ticket takes you out and back, which in Australia names the remote interior

explanation.definitionFit: The Australian bush interior, far from the coast, is known by a name joining outward and homeward.

clue.text: Cathedral with diocese in Paris!

parts.note: Ely in Cambridgeshire has a famous cathedral
a see is a bishop's diocese

explanation.surface: Muses on a cathedral and its diocese located in Paris.
explanation.walkthrough: ELY is a cathedral city in eastern England.
explanation.definitionFit: The Elysée Palace in Paris is the official residence of the French president.

clue.text: Made an impression in artwork

parts.note: an engraver cuts lines into a plate with acid, literally making an impression

explanation.definitionFit: Etching cuts a design into metal or glass, a printmaking technique in art.

clue.text: Swedish youngster's part is attractive

indicators.note: part says the answer is a portion of the letters of Swedish youngster's

explanation.surface: Remarks that a part of a young Swede is good-looking.
explanation.definitionFit: Dishy is informal British slang for good-looking or sexy.

clue.text: Suppress the endless tripe let out

indicators.note: endless says the word the loses its final letter

parts.note: tripe is nonsense, rot

indicators.note: out shows the letters of let are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone tries to stifle nonsense being released.
explanation.definitionFit: To throttle is to choke or strangle, hence to stifle or suppress.

clue.text: Flung from end to end as reported

indicators.note: as reported means the word for end to end is said aloud, giving a word of the same sound

parts.note: through means from one end to the other

explanation.surface: Something thrown along the length of a space.
explanation.definitionFit: Threw is the past tense of throw, and flung is the past tense of fling.

clue.text: Do not start to mismanage distribution of powder

indicators.note: distribution means the remaining letters are spread into a new order
do not start means drop the first letter of mismanage

explanation.surface: An instruction not to begin mishandling a delivery of powder.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Do not start' leaves ISMANAGE, which 'distribution of' rearranges.
explanation.definitionFit: Magnesia is magnesium oxide, a white powder used as an antacid and laxative.

clue.text: Stampede over long grass

parts.note: on can mean over, as something lying on top
a rush is a tall grasslike marsh plant

explanation.surface: Animals stampede across tall grass.
explanation.definitionFit: An onrush is a forceful forward surge, like a charging herd.

clue.text: Agent accepts shelter when tired

indicators.note: accepts means the word for agent takes the shelter word inside it

parts.note: a secret agent is a spy
the lee is the sheltered side, protected from wind

explanation.surface: An exhausted secret agent takes refuge.
explanation.definitionFit: Sleepy means drowsy, as one is when weary.

clue.text: Coming from reef we'd reportedly found invasive plant

parts.note: a reef is a kind of knot

indicators.note: reportedly means the contraction we'd is heard as a word that sounds alike

parts.note: the contraction of we would, said aloud

explanation.surface: Suggests sailors near a reef stumbled on a troublesome plant.
explanation.definitionFit: Japanese knotweed is a notoriously aggressive, invasive garden plant.
